title: Episodes and triggers
intro: A place to note a hard moment and what helped, in your own words. Nothing here is a label or a judgement.

log.title: Log a moment
log.whatHelpedHint: Optional, up to 200 characters. Encrypted, and seen only by you.
log.intensityRequired: Choose an intensity from 1 to 5 to save.

past.title: Past episodes
past.empty: Nothing logged yet. If a hard moment comes, you can note it here and what helped.

triggers.title: Your triggers
triggers.intro: Things you have noticed tend to come before a hard moment. They are your words, for your own use.
triggers.label: Name
triggers.labelHint: For example: exam week, a late night, a call from home.
triggers.empty: No triggers yet. Add one if you notice something that often comes first.
triggers.preferredNone: No exercises are available to choose yet.
triggers.required: Give the trigger a short name.
